title: Alinea SMP
description: A whitelisted Minecraft SMP with proximity voice chat, player-run provinces, and a real economy. No teleports, no land claims. Just a small world where you actually know your neighbours.
body:
Alinea is a whitelisted Minecraft SMP built around one idea: players should actually run into each other. The world is small on purpose. There are no teleport commands, and a province system keeps everyone living close together, so you end up knowing your neighbours, bumping into friends on the road, and striking up conversations just by walking past someone.

## Proximity voice chat

Hear people as you approach them. No need to hop into a Discord call or stop to type. It changes everything about how the game feels.

## Provinces

Players live together in [provinces](https://alinea.gg/provinces/) with their own rulers, laws, and economies. Some are democracies, some are monarchies, and the politics between them happen naturally. You'll find your place.

## A real economy

Every trade on Alinea is between real players. There are no admin shops and no artificial prices. Whether you want to run a shop, supply a business, or just scrape by, your time and effort have genuine value here.

## Always something to work toward

We've rebalanced progression so the game doesn't end in a week. Join on day 1 or day 100 and there's always more to chase. Custom [enchantments](https://alinea.gg/enchantments/) like Tree Feller and Stone Grafting add new goals, and an unstable enchanting system lets you push vanilla enchantments beyond their normal limits.

## No commands, just gameplay

You won't find `/tpa`, `/claim`, or `/home` here. Everything is done through real gameplay, hand-crafted to be as intuitive as possible.

## The community

Alinea has been running since 2020, and our players are 16+. Many have stuck around for years. This isn't a server you join for a weekend. If you're looking for somewhere people actually remember your name, this is it.
